arguments.command: cd $GITHUB_WORKSPACE && git pull -q --ff-only && sed -n 60,100p .github/workflows/pi-assistant.yml; cat .github/workflows/release.yml; for r in actions/checkout actions/setup-node actions/dependency-review-action actions/create-github-app-token cv/pi-action; do echo "$r $(gh api repos/$r/releases/latest --jq .tag_name)"; done
